t: A tiny breadboard FPGA board for learning to design digital circuits in Verilog.
steps: Buy a TinyFPGA BX from the Crowd Supply listing.
Install an open FPGA toolchain such as APIO or OSS-CAD-Suite, plus tinyprog with pip.
On Linux, add your user to the dialout group to reach the serial port.
Plug the board into your computer with a good micro USB cable.
Download the official blink template from the TinyFPGA BX guide.
Build the design and upload it with tinyprog.
Change the blink pattern and upload again.
Press reset to return to the bootloader for the next upload.
meta: Wild Open. From $49. A few stores.
